specialist_trace.rationale: For accurate coding, the clinical documentation must specify the stage and etiology of chronic kidney disease (e.g., CKD stage 3 due to diabetic nephropathy) and clarify whether it is acute or chronic, as this directly impacts severity and management. Additionally, specify the type of hyperlipidemia (e.g., pure hypercholesterolemia vs. mixed) and any related severity, and document the presence or absence of hypertensive complications (e.g., heart or renal involvement) and diabetic complications (e.g., nephropathy, neuropathy, retinopathy) or uncontrolled status, as these are essential for precise code assignment. Without these details, the coded data will underrepresent the patient’s true clinical complexity and risk.
